description: Fetch a Sentry resource by URL or ID: issues, events, traces, spans, agent conversations, replays, monitors, dashboards, preprod snapshots, and snapshot images. Start here for any Sentry URL or issue, event, trace, or replay ID; the type is detected from the URL. To list agent conversations, use search_agent_conversations.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

packageNames.description: Exact, case-sensitive package names recorded on the event. Returns their versions. Only for an event URL or the `event` type.

resourceId.description: The ID for the resource type: issue short ID (e.g. `PROJECT-123`), event, trace, replay, or conversation ID, monitor slug, dashboard ID or exact title, or snapshot artifact ID. Required without a URL.

resourceType.description: Required without a URL. With a URL, `trace` widens a span URL to its whole trace. `ai_conversation` is a gen_ai.conversation.id; `snapshot` is a preprod snapshot.

url.description: A Sentry URL. The resource type is detected from it.

name: get_sentry_resource
title: Get Sentry Resource
